title: package-mac-app
responsibility: Assemble the unsigned Harness.app from the installed Electron distribution under a Harness-named executable with no group or other write access, and refuse bundles that break either rule.

inputs.name: assembleMacApp.output
inputs.description: Path of the Harness.app bundle to create.

inputs.name: assembleMacApp.sources
inputs.description: Built main and preload bundle directory, built renderer directory, and the source revision stamped into the app.

inputs.name: restrictBundleModes.app
inputs.description: App bundle whose files and directories lose group and other write access; symbolic links are not followed.

outputs.name: bundleId
outputs.description: Bundle identifier of the Harness Mac release.

outputs.name: migrationBinary
outputs.description: Bundle-relative path of the Keychain migration helper.

outputs.name: assembleMacApp
outputs.description: Resolves when the unsigned bundle, its helpers and the bundled Tracker are staged.

outputs.name: restrictBundleModes
outputs.description: Returns after the modes are changed.

outputs.name: verifyMacAppLayout
outputs.description: Returns when the executable is named Harness, exists, and nothing is group or world writable.

errors.name: MacPackageError
errors.description: The executable is missing or not named Harness, or a bundle entry is writable by group or others.
